result.summary: Found several visual and content issues: a critical broken delivery price showing '€NaN', truncated restaurant names, and minor layout/cutoff problems on cards and category chips.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows delivery fee as '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed number format or missing data.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee data binding/formatting so a valid currency value (or a fallback like '—') is always displayed instead of NaN.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size, or ensure cards give enough width so full names remain readable.

issues.description: Category filter chips are clipped on the right edge (partial 'Healthy' chip and next item cut off), with no clear affordance that the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll padding/fade and ensure the last visible chip isn’t hard-clipped; optionally show a scroll hint.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza) and its content appear partially cut off at the bottom of the viewport above the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding so cards aren’t obscured by the fixed tab bar when scrolling ends.

issues.description: Delivery time badges sit over food images with limited contrast in places, which can hurt legibility.
issues.suggestion: Use a stronger scrim or higher-contrast badge background so time labels stay readable on all images.
